name: Supplier Environmental Assessment
purpose: GRI 308: Supplier Environmental Assessment 2016 contains disclosures for organizations to report information about their environmental impacts in their supply chain, and how they manage these impacts. The disclosures enable an organization to provide information on its approach to preventing and mitigating negative environmental impacts in its supply chain.
